goal: Explain a new pieces-to-object account and argue from wax, toast and frozen/thawed-fruit evidence about changes and attempted returns.
note: Year-end part 1, week 28. Two independent framed paper tasks: 2-PS1-3 observed before/after/parts records support an account of the same pieces making a new whole, properties fitting uses and pieces joining/separating; 2-PS1-4 new wax melting/hardening, toast and slowly frozen/thawed soft-fruit sequences establish heating AND cooling, reversible AND lasting changes and attempted returns with cause-based evidence. No cell explanation, flame or cooking. Fifteen minutes each task plus five minutes directions. Forms differ from the last two weeks habitat survey/inventory. Response day 76 only.
supplies: unfamiliar object before-and-after and piece-property cards (no-kit); wax and toast change/return images (no-kit); dated frozen/thawed-soft-fruit evidence images (no-kit); framed record

goal: Plan a fresh light and water investigation and carry out and record its starting measurements, then interpret supplied later observations.
note: Year-end part 2, week 28, one newly sampled code. Six groups of five at four minutes each plus six minutes set-up/transitions and five minutes record completion. Each child plans two single-factor comparisons against light-plus-water, conducts and dates an own baseline measurement/condition observation, then uses supplied later data to decide BOTH needs through cause/effect. Others independently complete the new framed plan/evidence sheet. No claim to grow plants in one lesson: identifiable unit 5 longitudinal conducting records are carried forward as existing evidence, never re-scored. Carry days 63/64 model and day 72 habitat records unchanged; day 72 is within ten days, so no new model/inventory task and neither code is listed. Fresh investigation form differs from recent inventory observations. No-kit: children plan, measure supplied scaled dated images and record their own observations; label supplied growth data as weaker evidence. Response day 76 only.
supplies: matched pre-grown untreated seedlings in cups/trays; centimeter rulers; fresh dated plant measurements and images (no-kit); individual plan and dated record
safety: soil: wash hands after handling; mould: adult discards promptly without student handling; seeds: untreated and not eaten; water spills: wiped at once
